cases.name: Chain a favorite into the menu
cases.prompt: A two-serving bean bowl uses 2 cups of beans. Serve it twice for two this week. I have 2 cups. Make the plan and shopping entry.
expectations: Names the meal-planning and pantry steps.
Calculates 4 cups of total bean demand.
Lists 2 cups to buy after one stock deduction.

cases.name: Keep a food wish distinct
cases.prompt: A stall sells dumplings I hope to try in October. I haven't tasted them. Save this somewhere I can copy.
expectations: Routes the entry to Wishful Tastes.
Records the dumplings and October target.
Marks the experience as a wish with no rating.
Returns a copyable record without claiming it was saved externally.

cases.name: Unknown allergen
cases.prompt: Plan meals from my usual family recipes for someone with a peanut allergy. You have no recipes here.
expectations: Carries the allergy as a hard constraint.
Requests ingredient lists for the missing family recipes.
Offers an editable menu outline without inventing family favorites.
